title: Logic Drummer Tricks
intro: Drummer is not a loop library. It is a performance engine that responds to what the rest of your arrangement is doing, and once you know where the controls are it will out‑play most programmed parts.

tips.t: Set the Follow parameter to your bass or guitar track
tips.d: In the Drummer Editor, the Follow menu makes the kick pattern lock to the rhythm of another track. Your drums and bass become one part instead of two.

tips.t: Use the X/Y pad, then fine‑tune with the individual sliders
tips.d: The pad sets loud/soft against simple/complex. The sliders to the right control each kit piece independently, which is where the real detail lives.

tips.t: Change the drummer, not just the preset
tips.d: Each drummer character has genuinely different playing tendencies. If a preset is close but the feel is wrong, swap the drummer and keep the settings.

tips.t: Turn individual kit pieces on and off per region
tips.d: Click a kit piece in the editor to enable or disable it for that region only. Drop the crash out of the verse and back in for the chorus.

tips.t: Set fill amount per region for real dynamics
tips.d: Zero fills in the verse, high fills in the last bar before the chorus. Fill amount is a per‑region setting — use it as an arrangement tool.

tips.t: Convert a Drummer region to MIDI and edit it by hand
tips.d: Right‑click the region and choose Convert > Convert to MIDI Region. You get the full performance in the Piano Roll to nudge, delete and re‑velocity as you like.

tips.t: Keep a Drummer region and a MIDI copy on two tracks
tips.d: Convert a copy to MIDI for hand editing but keep the original Drummer region muted on a second track. You can always regenerate.

tips.t: Use the Details panel for feel, ghost notes and hi‑hat
tips.d: Click the triangle in the Drummer Editor to reveal Feel (ahead or behind the beat), Ghost Notes and Hi‑Hat openness. This is where a stiff pattern becomes a groove.

tips.t: Give Drummer a groove template from your own track
tips.d: Drag any region to the Groove Track slot and set the Drummer track to follow it, so the drums swing exactly like your guitar does.

tips.t: Swap the kit without losing the performance
tips.d: The Drummer track's plugin is Drum Kit Designer. Change the kit, tune individual drums, and adjust room and overhead levels without touching a single note.
